name: kg_describe_node
description:
This tool provides a comprehensive description of a specific node from the knowledge graph, including:

- All node properties (label, semantic_label, category, description, node_type, etc.)
- Temporal information (start_date, end_date, valid_during)
- Node attributes and metadata
- Sample of inbound and outbound connections with relationship types (default: 5 edges), if you want more edges (assuming there are specify higher number).
- Edge details including source and target node information

This too is for simple hydration of known node.  It should not be used to search for nodes.

inputs.name: node_ids
inputs.description: List of node UUIDs to describe in detail

inputs.name: max_edges
inputs.description: Maximum number of edges to return per node (default: 5)

inputs.name: include_raw
inputs.description: Whether to return raw JSON data instead of formatted text (default: false)

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_describe_node tool:

- node_ids (required): List of node UUIDs to describe in detail
- max_edges (optional): Maximum number of edges to return per node (default: 5)
- include_raw (optional): Whether to return raw JSON data instead of formatted text (default: false)

This tool provides comprehensive node information for multiple nodes at once, including all properties, attributes, and connections. Returns a sample of edges for better performance.
